decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series was a visible multi-product investment that extends the firm's established offer, so management is inclined to persist and attribute weak results to temporary market conditions, although as a niche departure it carries more risk than core lines.

The cleansing foam was publicly announced as the newest addition to the established Sandorini series and is central to the firm's core facial-care direction, so dropping it would contradict earlier commitments and is unlikely.
